gate_k10.read: The worst failure of the three rungs: -11.5 F1. The receipt-level CI excludes zero on the negative side, but the sign test does not corroborate (many ties; p=0.42), so by this project's own two-statistics rule the claim stays 'failure to demonstrate benefit, with a reliably negative mean driven partly by loss magnitude' - not 'demonstrated harm'.

addendum_a_closure.the_device_clean_scale_comparison: 0.5B and 1.5B share device and dtype (CPU/fp32), so this pair carries NO device confound. Scaling 3x made the paired delta WORSE (-7.3 -> -11.5). The scale hypothesis is dead on a clean comparison, not just on the confounded 4B one.
addendum_a_closure.spec_note: Addendum A called a 1.5B pass 'the strongest commercial outcome'. It is instead the largest failure.
addendum_a_closure.overall: The preregistered question is answered at every scale it named: one epoch of per-request LoRA adaptation has not been shown to beat k-shot prompting on CORD at 0.5B, 1.5B or 4B, and every point estimate is negative.
addendum_a_closure.what_remains: Only Addendum B (novel-schema gate) can now rescue the quality thesis - it tests the one regime Addendum A never touched. Relaunch on T4/bf16 at the 2026-08-15T00:00Z quota refresh.
